title_cyr: Не се седи, бабо, не се трпи
title_latin: Ne se sedi, babo, ne se trpi
title_en: I cannot sit still, Grandma, I cannot endure it

lines.cyr: - Не се седи, бабо, не се трпи,
lines.lat: - Ne se sedi, babo, ne se trpi,
lines.en: - I cannot sit still, Grandma, I cannot endure it,
this bachelor’s life of mine, Grandma.

lines.cyr: Цел ноќ седам, бабо, на дрвено,
lines.lat: Cel noḱ sedam, babo, na drveno,
lines.en: I sit all night, Grandma, upon a pile of wood,
a whole load of timber, Grandma, that I’ve ached,

lines.cyr: думае си, бабо, сè за неа.
lines.lat: dumae si, babo, sè za nea.
lines.en: and I think, Grandma, only of her.

lines.cyr: - Цел ноќ седиш, мале, на дрвено,
lines.lat: - Cel noḱ sediš, male, na drveno,
lines.en: - You sit all night, my son, upon the wood,
did you see, my son, who passed by?
- I saw them, Grandma, I saw them on the path,
And she wept for me, Grandma,

lines.cyr: што не му се, бабо, здодејува,
lines.lat: što ne mu se, babo, zdodejuva,
lines.en: he never tires of it, Grandma,
filling a whole cup with tears, Grandma.
She fills a cup with tears, Grandma,

lines.cyr: Думае си, бабо, сè за неа,
lines.lat: Dumae si, babo, sè za nea,
lines.en: I keep thinking, Grandma, only of her,

lines.cyr: сè за неа, бабо, сè по неа.
lines.lat: sè za nea, babo, sè po nea.
lines.en: all about her, Grandma, always for her.
